evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'this will take about ten minutes. Sounds good.' but does not wait for explicit yes and does not mention dependable quote or time-boxed framing in full form.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Alyssa), moving day (October 8th, then corrected by customer), city-to-city route (8800 Star Crest Drive apartment 101 to 14500 Blanco Road San Antonio), size (two bedroom apartment) — all four covered.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves directly into logistics probing after the time-box framing: 'So, yeah, to confirm Alyssa, you are moving from a ground floor two bedroom apartment...'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (ground floor two bedroom apartment to second floor two bedroom apartment), floor/stories (ground floor to second floor with stairs), rooms (two bedroom confirmed), walking distance (approximately 50 feet both locations), additional rooms/spaces (patio with bike, moped, grill, inversion table), special considerations (TV, washer/dryer, tall mirror), additional stops (none mentioned). All seven logistics items covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Yes: 'So yeah, I'll definitely provide you know, a quote with the packing services and the one for just moving, moving only, okay?'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes: 'a typical 1100 or two bedroom apartment usually has 25 to 35 boxes packed with belongings. So do you feel like you will fall within that range?'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full anchor provided: typical range of $2,406 for packing+moving vs. $1,143 for moving only, personalized to two-day packing service, stairs access, full packing services, and small miscellaneous items.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Fee transparency: 'there are no hidden fees of any type, no credit card fees, no transportation fees, no stairwell fees, no disassemble, reassembly fees.' Framing: 'time starts as soon as we get on site... two and a half hour minimum, and once we go over that the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep transitions directly to closing: 'So, what do you say would you like our help with, you know, the packing and the moving on October 8th and October 9th.'
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full: 'if we can't make it in the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Full: 'we provide up to $2,000 per move to repair replace or reimburse for accidental damages. The second is our media mover feature.' No mention of no deductible/no fine print, but $2,000 figure and repair/replace/reimburse framing present.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar closing question for the Two Promises section.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep jumps to 'will there be anything else?' which is a throwaway empty-question format, not a genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' version.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Partial with built-in out. Rep asks 'what do you say would you like our help with, you know, the packing and the moving on October 8th and October 9th' (explicit ask), but when customer hesitates and asks for email, rep says 'I'll send you a quote and yeah if you decide to book with us just give us a call back' — providing an easy out without a hard close or date confirmation.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Email confirmed (Houston Haley @gmail.com), date mentioned (October 8th and October 9th), but no phone number collected, no arrival window confirmed, no crew size confirmed, and no notes left for crew about customer concerns.

top_strength: Excellent logistics discovery — Jevic methodically gathered all seven detail categories (property type, floors, rooms, walking distance, additional spaces, special items, access concerns) and box-count estimation, building a comprehensive picture for accurate pricing.
coaching_note: Skip Section 2 (Their Agenda / Their Concerns) entirely — move directly to logistics probing after the time-box framing, but do not ask whether the customer has concerns about the move before you start pitching. Ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' before diving into floor plans and furniture lists.
